question.text: The tangent drawn to the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo></math> at point <math><mi>P</mi></math> in the first quadrant whose abscissa is <math><mn>5,</mn></math> meets the lines <math><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and <math><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> at <math><mi>Q</mi></math> and <math><mi>R</mi></math> respectively. If <math><mi>O</mi></math> is the origin, then the area of triangle <math><mi>O</mi><mi>Q</mi><mi>R</mi></math> is (in square units)

solution.text:
Let point P be 5,β since it lies on given hyperbola 2516-β29=1⇒β2=8116
Hence, β=94 (as P lies in first quadrant)
So, equation of tangent is 5x16-9y4⋅9=1⇒5x-4y=16
So, points Q and R are 8,6 and 2,-32
Hence, the area of triangle OQR is 1212+12=12 sq. units
